feeds.title: Paul Sellers Blog
feeds.description: Paul Sellers' woodworking blog with opinions on hand tool woodworking. You'll find woodworking tutorials, tips, and techniques.

feeds.title: Furniture and wood shavings
feeds.description: The Blog about Furniture And Wood Shavings written by Art lecturer based in Scotland Hazel Terry.

feeds.title: The English Woodworker Blog
feeds.description: The English Woodworker offers hand tool woodworking education online. Learn through detailed & entertaining woodworking videos, on hand tool set up, techniques, joinery, hand planing and more. We cover the basics right through to mastering your skills with hand tools.

feeds.title: David Barron Furniture
feeds.description: A Woodworking furniture blog by David Barron. I am married with two children and am a woodworking fanatic! I make fine furniture as well as a range of very popular hand tools which I demonstrate and sell at shows. I teach woodworking courses at West Dean College as well as write regular articles for Furniture and Cabinetmaking magazine.

feeds.title: A Bodger's Blog
feeds.description: Green Woodwork and Pole Lathe tuition & maker of stools chairs bowls spoons & all types of treen. How to make ideas on the spring pole lathe, bow lathe, shavehorse. Turning in an ecological ethical way with a green footprint & hand tools.

feeds.title: The World Of Carvings With Stories
feeds.description: A blog by a Bristol UK based woodcarver, with current woodcarving and other projects that I'm involved in, my courses and youth work, and lots more.

feeds.title: Wood Workers Workshop
feeds.description: Wood Workers Workshop is the only shop where you can buy online plus get the benefit of seeing product demonstrations by woodworkers and a chance to inspect the quality of our fantastic products, here in the heart of England in Worcestershire. We have the best in-house routing set-up in the UK - the full range of JessEm and INCRA routing systems is always set up here at our teaching workshops for you to view anytime.

feeds.title: The Woodworker Magazine
feeds.description: Welcome to Get Woodworking, the online home of Good Woodworking and The Woodworker magazines.
